units.note: Ninety lembi = 50 (Demetrius) + 40 (Scerdilaidas). Chapter-end lacuna/break marked with [...].
Greek breaks mid-word at the chapter end (τὴν θρέ- / -ψασαν); English completes it across the seam, which is a chapter split, not a lacuna. Three hundred exiles correct.

findings.quote: They treated all the others of that party in the same way
findings.problem: Greek: ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ τοῖς ἄλλοις ἐχρήσαντο πᾶσι, 'they treated all the others alike', i.e. the other townspeople generally. 'Of that party' is not in the Greek and narrows the sense.
findings.proposed_fix: They treated all the others in the same way

units.note: Two days late (δυσὶ ἡμέραις) correct; Euripidas, Taurion, Demetrius of Pharos correctly identified.
Thirty years, Philoxenus and Timotheus, Ephorus all correct.
